no_progress_definition: target episode >=3s whose distance never shrank by max(100px, 10% of start distance)

round2_definitions.air_down_self_ringout: same fighter rang out within 2.0 s after starting a basic air-down
round2_definitions.block: damage signal arrived while the defender was still guarding (wrong-direction guards are lowered before the signal)
round2_definitions.nova_launch_hit: Nova dealt PvP damage within 3.2 s after the slingshot launch
round2_definitions.parry: the 92x92 parry effect created by PlayerBase was observed and attributed to the nearby attacker receiving parry recoil
round2_definitions.reaction_in_recovery: reactive guard timer first seen after the observed attack's conservative per-character startup bound

round3_definitions.corner_escape: debug reason changed to 'cornered: jumping past'
round3_definitions.distance_buckets: target distance at exact attack_serial increment: 0-120, 120-240, 240-360, 360+ px
round3_definitions.recent_trade: the bot and dropped target exchanged a measured damage event in either direction during the prior 3.0 s
round3_definitions.recovery_skill: skill_1 coincided with attack_serial increment while state was recover; reached_floor means that recovery episode later exited recover without a ring-out
round3_definitions.target_drop: debug reason changed to 'gave up: target out of reach'; dropped target recovered from ignored_targets
round3_definitions.too_late: debug reason changed to 'too late to block' after a queued reaction expired
round3_definitions.yuki_near_ledge: Yuki's last attributed PvP hit before ring-out occurred while _cornered() found no floor within 225 px behind her, away from the attacker

round4_definitions.combo_block: a guarded damage event attributed to Frey/Rio ground-side combo step 2 or 3 from combo_step at attack_serial increment
round4_definitions.frey_recovery_entry: knocked_off if PvP-damaged within 3s; otherwise walked_or_dashed_off if recover began outside the realm sides or over void; remaining entries are other

round5_definitions.cornered_guard: guard raised on a new hold decision while escape_cooldown > 0 and _cornered() is true; block is attributed while that guard remains recent
round5_definitions.progress_extension: rising change of EnemyAI.progress_extended; dropped_after_extension means that same target later entered ignored_targets
round5_definitions.recovery_skill_ask: rising edge of EnemyAI.recovery_skill_asked; used remains an observed character activation, not an intent

round6_definitions.progress_extension: removed in round 6; extension totals and events remain empty for schema compatibility
round6_definitions.recovery_episode: monotonic per-fighter recovery entry number; repeated uses in one recovery share the same number
round6_definitions.recovery_skill_ask: totals count each physics frame carrying a recover-state skill_1 intent; event rows are sampled to successful-looking frames plus first/last rejected frames per seed and character
